# SEO and GEO audit: Ledger site I read all 10 tracked files. Findings are ordered by impact. This is a static read of the source: I didn't build or run the site, and `/api/posts` isn't in the repo. ## High impact **1. Pricing page is `noindex`, yet it's in the sitemap and has a canonical** (`app/pricing/page.tsx:1`) - `robots: { index: false, follow: true }` keeps your most commercial page out of Google and out of AI answers about cost. - It also contradicts `public/sitemap.xml:4` and the canonical on the same line. - **Fix:** delete the `robots` property. If the noindex is deliberate, remove the page from the sitemap instead. **2. Blog is client-rendered, so crawlers see an empty page** (`app/blog/page.tsx:1-10`) - `'use client'` plus `useEffect` fetching `/api/posts` means the server HTML contains only `

Blog

`. Many AI crawlers don't run JavaScript, so none of the posts reach them. - There is no `/api/posts` route anywhere in the repo, so the page may be empty for everyone. - A client component can't export `metadata`, so the page has no title, description or canonical of its own. It inherits the layout defaults. - **Fix:** - Make it a server component and load posts on the server with `async`/`await`. - Export `metadata`. - Give each post its own route (`app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`) with its own title, description, canonical and `Article` JSON-LD. - Link to those posts from the list. - Until real posts exist, remove `/blog` from `public/sitemap.xml:6` or accept that it's a thin page. **3. `robots.txt` doesn't enforce your policy** (`public/robots.txt:1-5`, against `geo.config.json:6-9`) - Your policy is to allow AI search and block training. Only `GPTBot` is blocked. Other training crawlers fall under `Allow: /`. - Missing: `Google-Extended`, `CCBot`, `ClaudeBot`, `anthropic-ai`, `Applebot-Extended`, `Bytespider`, `meta-externalagent`. - Search and retrieval bots (`OAI-SearchBot`, `ChatGPT-User`, `Claude-SearchBot`, `PerplexityBot`) are allowed through `*`. That matches your policy, but it's implicit. I'd add explicit `Allow` groups so it survives later edits. - There is also no `Sitemap:` line. Add `Sitemap: https://www.ledger.example/sitemap.xml`. ## Medium impact **4. `` has no `lang`** (`app/layout.tsx:11`) - `geo.config.json:4` says `en`. Use ``. **5. No structured data anywhere** - Add JSON-LD in `app/layout.tsx`: `Organization` and `WebSite`. - Add `SoftwareApplication` with an `Offer` on `app/page.tsx` and `app/pricing/page.tsx`. - This is the main way AI engines pick up what Ledger is and what it costs. **6. Content is too thin to be cited** (`app/page.tsx:4`, `app/docs/page.tsx:3`, `app/pricing/page.tsx:3`) - Each page is one `

` and one sentence. - Add specifics that answer questions directly: features, a plan table with prices, who it's for, and an FAQ. Use `

` sections. - Docs should have real setup steps. Pricing says "Free for up to three people" but gives no paid tiers. **7. Titles and descriptions are weak or inconsistent** - `app/docs/page.tsx:1` has the title "Docs", and `app/pricing/page.tsx:1` has "Pricing". Neither names the brand or the topic. - `app/layout.tsx:5-6` and `app/page.tsx:1` repeat the same generic description. - **Fix:** set `title: { default: ..., template: '%s | Ledger' }` in the layout. Then use descriptive page titles, for example "Ledger pricing: free for up to 3 people". **8. Missing canonical on docs** (`app/docs/page.tsx:1`) - Home and pricing have one; docs doesn't. - Better: set `alternates: { canonical: './' }` once in the layout metadata, since `metadataBase` is already set (`app/layout.tsx:4`). ## Low impact **9. No Open Graph or Twitter metadata** (`app/layout.tsx:3-7`) - Add `openGraph` (title, description, url, siteName, image) and `twitter`. **10. Sitemap has no ``** (`public/sitemap.xml:3-6`) - Add dates. Better still, generate it with `app/sitemap.ts` so new posts are included automatically. **11. No `llms.txt`** - Optional. A short `public/llms.txt` summarising the product and linking to key pages helps some AI tools. ## Fine as is - `app/thank-you/page.tsx:1` is correctly `noindex` and is not in the sitemap. - `metadataBase` is set, and the nav links are plain crawlable `` tags. - `data-nosnippet` on the cookie notice (`app/layout.tsx:15`) is appropriate. I haven't changed any files. I can apply these fixes if you want. I'd start with #1, #3, #4 and the blog server rendering in #2.
